Petals & Props — Wedding Decor, Lighting & Styling, Mumbai

Petals & Props is a Mumbai decor and styling studio known for elaborate,
high-production wedding setups — imported florals, custom-fabricated props,
dramatic lighting, and large-scale stage builds for luxury weddings across
Mumbai and destination venues.

Their luxury wedding decor packages start at ₹8,50,000 and scale well past
₹20,00,000 for multi-day destination productions. They offer end-to-end design,
fabrication, and on-site execution with a dedicated project manager.

Contact: +91 98203 31190 · studio@petalsandprops.example
Location: Lower Parel, Mumbai, Maharashtra
Rating: 4.6 / 5 (74 reviews)

What couples say:
"Absolutely jaw-dropping production — it looked like a film set."
"The custom props and imported flowers were worth every rupee."
"Dedicated project manager kept everything on track."

Petals & Props maintains an in-house fabrication unit, which lets them build
bespoke structures rather than relying on rentals. They typically take on a
limited number of large weddings per season and book several months in advance.

One issue surfaced in a few recent reviews: for a December 2023 destination
wedding, a significant portion of the imported floral order reportedly did not
arrive in time due to a logistics failure, and the team substituted local
flowers without informing the couple beforehand — the final setup differed
noticeably from the approved design. A separate client reported that the agreed
lighting rig was scaled down on the event day, again without prior notice, while
the full price was still charged. The studio has stated these were pandemic-era
supply disruptions it has since addressed with backup vendors.

For couples planning a high-budget, design-critical wedding, Petals & Props
offers exceptional production value, with the caveat that substitution and
change-notification terms are worth pinning down in the contract.
